title: XML input reaches ElementTree.parse without a hostile-input security regression
attacker_controlled_source: Caller-supplied local XML dataset path and its XML contents through XmlComicRepository
impact: Potential XML parser abuse is not established; the adapter is local-file based and no outbound entity/network sink is visible. The remaining question is parser hardening/hostile-input behavior.
why_plausible: The application exposes an XML adapter and parses XML directly. The discovery workflow requires parser-family closure, including hostile-input evidence, before suppression.
closest_apparent_control: No explicit DTD/entity prohibition or hardened parser configuration is present in the adapter.
proof_gap: Installed Finding Discovery environment is missing mandatory shared security-guidance/scan-artifacts reference; repository lacks a dedicated hostile-XML regression test. Static review found no network callback or external entity sink.
